MidMall Maipú

Mid-sized mall in Maipú, focused on practical shopping with a supermarket, food court and clothing and service stores for residents of the western zone.

Best for

  • Maipú residents
  • Neighbourhood shopping
  • Food court

Not ideal for

  • Tourists
  • Those looking for wide variety or larger-format malls

Getting there

No direct metro. Bus or car.

Recommended time: 1 hour
